project_type: MERN stack — Express/Mongoose backend + Vite/React 18 frontend, deployed to AWS
build_system: Frontend: Vite 5 (npm run build). Backend: plain Node/Express (node server.js / nodemon). No monorepo tooling.
test_framework: Frontend: Vitest 2 (npm run test in frontend/). Backend: Jest 29 (npm test in backend/).
test_command: cd frontend && npm run test    (frontend)   |   cd backend && npm test   (backend unit tests)
verification_instructions: 1. cd frontend && npm run build — must complete with 0 errors. 2. cd backend && node -e "require('./models/Guide')" — must not throw. 3. cd backend && npm test — existing Jest tests must still pass. 4. Manual smoke-test: start backend with 'node server.js', open frontend dev server with 'npm run dev', navigate all new routes.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell workspace. All paths use backslash outside shell commands. Do NOT restart a running dev server. Do NOT push to git — local commits only on the current branch.
contribution_requirements: Preserve all existing working features. Do not delete pages — only reorganise navigation. Backend permission checks must be enforced server-side (middleware), not only client-side. Use exact npm package versions already in package.json; do not introduce new dependencies unless strictly necessary.
key_patterns: - API service: import { api } from '../../../services/api'; api.get('/guides') etc. Returns response.data directly (axios interceptor unwraps). - Cards: import Card from '../../ui/Card'; props: title, subtitle, action, onClick, noPadding, variant, className. - Modals: import Modal from '../../ui/Modal'; props: isOpen, onClose, title, className, children. - Auth middleware exports: protect, admin, partner, optionalAuth from backend/middleware/authMiddleware.js. admin middleware allows role 'admin' OR 'super_admin'. - Page pattern: functional component with useState/useEffect, Card wrapper, lucide-react icons, framer-motion animations, tailwind utility classes, toast from react-hot-toast. - roleConfig.js: flat menuItems[] array per role key. Sidebar.jsx iterates menuItems[]. - asyncHandler from express-async-handler for all controller functions. - Guide model is registered as 'Guide' in Mongoose; server.js mounts guideRoutes at /api/guides.
directory_structure: backend/ — Express server: models/, controllers/, routes/, middleware/, services/, utils/. frontend/src/ — React app: pages/ (public pages + dashboard wrappers), components/ (dashboard/admin|student|partner, home, ui, common), services/ (api.js + per-feature services), utils/ (roleConfig.js), routes/ (AppRoutes.jsx), context/ (AuthContext, ThemeContext, SiteSettingsContext).
